title: Optimized molecular geometry
caption: Optimized neutral gas-phase local minimum. All 57 vibrational frequencies are positive. Carbon is gray, oxygen red and hydrogen white; labels match the one-based geometry tables.

title: Predicted infrared spectrum
caption: Unscaled gas-phase harmonic IR spectrum with Lorentzian display broadening of 20 cm⁻¹ FWHM. Band positions and intensities are computational predictions.

title: Predicted Raman activities
caption: Unscaled gas-phase harmonic Raman activities, broadened with a 20 cm⁻¹ Lorentzian FWHM. Activities are not laser- or temperature-specific experimental intensities.

title: Gas-phase UV absorption
caption: Forty singlet vertical full TD-DFT transitions. The static display uses Gaussian broadening of 0.25 eV FWHM; it is not experimentally calibrated.

title: Neutral-water-model UV absorption
caption: Forty singlet vertical full TD-DFT transitions at the relaxed neutral CPCM-water geometry. Static Gaussian broadening is 0.25 eV FWHM; no pH-dependent protonation ensemble is modeled.

title: Predicted hydrogen chemical shifts
caption: Gas-phase atom-resolved ¹H shifts from calculated TMS referencing. One equal-height stick per atom; no J coupling, exchange, solvent or conformer averaging.

title: Predicted carbon chemical shifts
caption: Gas-phase atom-resolved ¹³C shifts from calculated TMS referencing. One equal-height stick per atom; no full experimental spectral simulation is implied.

title: Gas-phase Hirshfeld charges
caption: Hirshfeld charges at the original neutral gas-phase local minimum. Charges depend on the population scheme and are not measured observables.

title: CPCM-water Hirshfeld charges
caption: Hirshfeld charges at the relaxed neutral CPCM-water geometry. Values describe this model and do not determine aqueous protonation populations.

title: Relative Gibbs energies of sampled candidates
caption: Relative printed Gibbs energies of seven frequency-validated candidates. Repeated and mirror-related structures are retained; the plot does not represent seven unique conformers, ensemble populations or a proven global minimum.

title: Symmetry-aware conformer similarity
caption: Pairwise all-atom RMSD after four verified connectivity-preserving permutations, with equivalent aromatic Kekulé drawings treated identically. Reflections are excluded; C1/C2/C4 are near-duplicates at a 0.10 Å grouping threshold.

title: HOMO orbital, gas
caption: Finite-basis HOMO Kohn–Sham orbital at the original gas-phase geometry. Colors indicate opposite orbital phases, not atomic charge. The displayed isovalue is stated on the figure. Virtual-orbital energy does not establish a bound attached-electron state.
